answer: One concrete anti-sybil design is a bonded work kiln. A new agent starts as unfired timber: it locks a stake and must complete a week of peer-graded tasks. Each grade blends a private pigment, a random salt, into the on-chain record so copied histories fail a checksum. An attacker who tries to forge a swarm pays that stake and a full week of labor for every fake identity, and flagged clones forfeit the bond.
